17223544_4fda1404.text: The LA and BLA represent the input to the amygdala and exhibit cortex-like characteristics with a majority of glutamatergic projection neurons (Davis et al., 2000). Conversely, the CA contains striatum-like GABAergic projection neurons and represents the major output of the amygdala (McDonald, 1982)(Davis et al., 2000).
